neighbours.label: An opening quote mark that begins a spoken or printed message
fire: Halfway through dinner my uncle looked up and shouted “Who left the gate open?” at nobody.
The teacher turned from the board and whispered “Please sit down,” without smiling.
On the way out he stopped at the door, then added “Don't wait up for me.”
My neighbour never says hello; she just yells “Your dog is barking again!” over the fence.
quiet: During the meal my aunt glanced over and frowned at the clock for a moment.
The coach walked away from the bench and sat down in silence without smiling.
Before leaving he paused near the door, then took his coat and went out.
My neighbour rarely waves; she just waters her roses early and goes back indoors.

notes: Peaks on opening quotes after print, return or a speech verb. A quoted config value (name = 'default') stayed quiet in probing, so the label is the message, not the quote character.
